svg.title: Observer
svg.desc: Observer. A subject notifies its subscribed observers of every change, so one change updates many dependents it never names. Step 1, The cart calls every view: Cart.add() calls each view itself: Cart depends on every view, and a fourth view means editing Cart. Step 2, Subscribe and notify: The views subscribe; Cart keeps a list of Observers and calls update(cart) on each after a change. Step 3, One change, many updates: add(Mug, 12), then add(Lamp, 45): each change notifies all three views; each reads what it needs. Step 4, Pitfalls, and at scale: Unsubscribe when a view goes away, or the list keeps it alive; mind order, loops and slow observers.

g.text: Cart.add() calls each view itself: Cart depends on every view, and a fourth view means editing Cart.
The views subscribe; Cart keeps a list of Observers and calls update(cart) on each after a change.
add(Mug, 12), then add(Lamp, 45): each change notifies all three views; each reads what it needs.
Unsubscribe when a view goes away, or the list keeps it alive; mind order, loops and slow observers.
Cart names every view class and calls each one’s own method
a fourth view means editing Cart again
still listed: the closed banner stays alive
unsubscribe() took it off the list
Cart holds Observer references only: it never names a view class
a fourth view would just subscribe; Cart is not edited
pull: update(cart) hands over the cart; each view reads count or total
push, the alternative: update({ count, total }) sends the data itself
the order of updates is not guaranteed
an update() that edits the cart can loop
sync: a slow or failing update() blocks the rest
